name: Small Fort on the River opposite the Factories, Canton
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of the 'Red Fort' with Tanka boats alongside. This fort (often confused with the Haizhu or 'Dutch folly' fort) lay on the north bank of the Pearl River in the district of Honan, opposite the 'factories' at Canton (Guangzhou).
